subject: Transportation Systems
title: Building Around Buried History
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Building Around Buried History.

hook.text: Subway crews in Rome once found an ancient aqueduct. They had to reroute the entire tunnel.

buildup.text: Old cities are layered with buried pipes, cables, foundations, and sometimes actual ruins.

discovery.text: Athens' metro doubled as an archaeological dig. Workers uncovered 50,000 artifacts during construction.

twist.text: In Mexico City, an Aztec temple was found during metro excavation. It's now displayed in the station.

climax.text: Every old city hides surprises underground. Subway builders must be part engineer, part historian.

punchline.text: Building a subway is also an archaeology project.

quiz.question: What did Athens' metro construction uncover?
